product_metadata.title: MGA Surprise 14oz Water Bottle with Star Shaped Reusable Ice Cubes
features: Surprise Water Bottle w/ Star Shaped Reusable Ice Cubes 14oz.
Bottle is pink with characters Crystal Queen, Cosmic Queen, and Glitter Queen along with star and camera icons and text "Hi Bae". Lid is light blue with a light purple cap.

Easy-open flip-up spout and straw. Cap opens when you press the button.Screw on-off lid with wide mouth, easily accommodates ice cubes.4 Star-Shaped Plastic Reusable Ice Cubes can be frozen and reused.
Included adjustable shoulder strap for easy carry.Bottle with cap measures approximately 6.5" and 3.5" diameter.Holds 14oz of liquids, water, juice etc.Not Dishwasher safe and Not microwave safe.
Not recommended for children under the age of 3. Reusable Ice Cubes may pose as a choking hazard.
